name: cso-thinking
description: Single-command security audit (/cso-audit) that adapts to any target — frontend, backend (any language), infrastructure, databases, Android, iOS, or generic software. Auto-detects relevant profiles, runs a hybrid scan (external tools + checklist review), produces a composite security score (0–100 + letter grade), and emits SECURITY_AUDIT.md + SECURITY_AUDIT.html with a fix-ready audit list.
